verified_facts.text: The hotel is at 1000 Broadway in downtown Nashville, near The Gulch and Midtown.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located near The Gulch and Midtown, our downtown hotel puts you close to a rich music scene, exquisite dining and top attractions in Nashville, Tennessee.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is steps from shopping at The Gulch, events at The Pinnacle and entertainment at Fifth + Broadway.
verified_facts.excerpt: From shopping at The Gulch to events at The Pinnacle to immersive entertainment at Fifth + Broadway, you’ll be steps from it all while staying at Grand Hyatt Nashville.

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites have hardwood floors and floor-to-ceiling windows.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our luxury rooms and suites feature gorgeous hardwood floors, floor-to-ceiling windows for plenty of natural light and upscale bath amenities.

verified_facts.text: Rooms include blackout curtains and Balmain bath amenities.
verified_facts.excerpt: a few luxurious touches, including blackout curtains and Balmain bath amenities

verified_facts.text: Gulch View rooms are on the upper floors and offer sunset views facing The Gulch.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on floors 16–22 of the hotel, this 360-square-foot room boasts one king bed, floor-to-ceiling windows, hardwood floors and sunset views facing The Gulch.

verified_facts.text: Suites offer more room and a separate living area.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stay in a suite and enjoy more room and a separate living area.

verified_facts.text: The June Presidential Suite is on the top floor and looks out over the Nashville skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy the sweeping Nashville skyline in this 1,550-square-foot suite with spacious seating and dining areas and a bedroom with a king bed. Located on the top floor of the hotel, this is a premium suite.

verified_facts.text: The Grand Club Lounge on the Lobby Level has an outdoor terrace overlooking downtown and serves breakfast, all-day refreshments, evening hors d'oeuvres, and beer and wine.
verified_facts.excerpt: featuring open seating, a private conference room, and a serene outdoor terrace overlooking the energy of downtown. Savor a curated selection of breakfast offerings, all-day refreshments, evening hors d’oeuvres, and premium beer and wine.

verified_facts.text: Grand Club Lounge access is for guests of Club Access rooms and suites and select World of Hyatt tiers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Access to the Grand Club Lounge is reserved exclusively for registered guests of Club Access rooms and suites, as well as select World of Hyatt tiers.

verified_facts.text: The R+R Wellness spa's name stands for Recharge and Replenish and pays homage to the Nashville Yards railroad region.
verified_facts.excerpt: Paying homage to the culture of downtown’s Nashville Yards and railroad region, R+R stands for Recharge and Replenish.

verified_facts.text: The heated outdoor pool and sundeck on the fifth-floor Lifestyle Level have panoramic views of downtown Nashville.
verified_facts.excerpt: Soak up the season with a swim in our heated outdoor pool or relax on the sundeck, where panoramic views of downtown Nashville set the scene.

verified_facts.text: The pool and Solstice poolside restaurant are open seasonally from early spring through late October, weather permitting.
verified_facts.excerpt: The pool and Solstice poolside restaurant are open seasonally from early spring through late October, weather permitting, on our 5th floor Lifestyle Level.

verified_facts.text: The fitness center is open 24 hours, with weight equipment, cardio machines and three Pelotons.
verified_facts.excerpt: Re-energize during your Nashville stay in our 24-hour fitness center, complete with weight equipment, cardio machines and three Pelotons

verified_facts.text: The rooftop venue lou/na is named for the Louisville and Nashville rail lines that once passed through the hotel's site, and has indoor and outdoor seating with views of Nashville.
verified_facts.excerpt: And you will feel like the moon is within reach from this stunning rooftop venue that features indoor and outdoor seating, entertainment and breathtaking views of Nashville and beyond.

verified_facts.text: The Louisville and Nashville rail lines passed directly through the site of the hotel for over a century.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by legendary Louisville & Nashville rail lines that passed directly through the site of the Grand Hyatt for over a century

verified_facts.text: The Nashville Grange on the Lobby Level serves breakfast, lunch and dinner from a 'Tennessee to table' menu, with views of Broadway and Union Station.
verified_facts.excerpt: Serving breakfast, lunch and dinner, The Nashville Grange is located on the Lobby Level and features incredible views of famed Broadway, nearby Union Station and the vibrant, surrounding city.

verified_facts.text: Aurum, the lobby lounge, has live music and a signature locally sourced golden ale.
verified_facts.excerpt: local brews- including a locally sourced and signature label golden ale- plus an upscale menu of small bites and local flavors. Luxury meets industry in this inspired space that is a place to be seen. Live music performed Thursday through Sunday.

verified_facts.text: Hummingbird Coffee Market brews coffee from local roaster Good Citizen Coffee.
verified_facts.excerpt: They proudly brew coffee and specialty espresso drinks from a local roaster, Good Citizen Coffee.

verified_facts.text: Le Petit Chef is an immersive culinary and dinner theater experience at the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Le Petit Chef, an immersive culinary adventure and dinner theater experience featuring regional and international delicacies.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers a premium single-barrel Tennessee whiskey tasting.
verified_facts.excerpt: Embark on a sensory journey through the rich history of Tennessee's iconic spirit as you savor the complexities of premium single-barrel whiskey at Grand Hyatt Nashville.

verified_facts.text: The Grand Hall wedding venue has floor-to-ceiling windows and access to a terrace with park views.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Grand Hall, which features floor-to-ceiling windows and access to a terrace with park views.

verified_facts.text: The hotel welcomes dogs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our hotel will only allow dogs in your room or suite.

verified_facts.text: Valet parking and self-parking are available.
verified_facts.excerpt: Paid valet parking is available for guests at our hotel in downtown Nashville.

verified_facts.text: Nashville International Airport (BNA) is 9 miles away.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nashville International Airport (BNA)9 miles
